# Arm/Elbow Audit — 2x2 Walk Cycle (facing right, katana low)

---

## TL (Frame 1 — stride open, back leg trailing)

**1) Sword arm (near side):** Shoulder (~278,148) → elbow (~310,215) → hand (~318,245). Upper arm angles down-forward; forearm drops nearly vertical to the hand. Elbow interior angle ≈ **150–160°**. Fold direction: elbow crease faces **forward/outward** — correct, flexion is anterior. Anatomically valid.

**2) Off arm (far side):** Shoulder (~270,148) → elbow (~255,215) → hand (~252,248). Hangs nearly straight behind torso; interior angle ≈ **165–175°**. Slight flexion forward — correct direction, but it reads as nearly locked straight (fine for a walk, borderline stiff).

**3) Defects:** No hyperextension, no inversion, no elbow-above-shoulder, no dislocation. The two arms are appropriately counter-phased (near arm forward, far arm back) — asymmetry is intentional gait asymmetry, not a bug.

**4) Blade:** Blade extends down-forward from the hand toward the front ankle; tip appears to **graze/pass just in front of the front shin (~300–315, 250–300)** — near-contact, no clear intersection with the leg mesh, but clearance is <5px. Flag as "grazing risk."

---

## TR (Frame 2 — passing pose, legs close)

**1) Sword arm:** Shoulder (~818,148) → elbow (~845,205) → hand (~848,235). Angle ≈ **155°**, flexion forward — correct.

**2) Off arm:** Shoulder (~810,148) → elbow (~800,205) → hand (~805,240). Angle ≈ **160–170°**, correct fold direction. Elbow sits slightly behind the torso line — acceptable.

**3) Defects:** None on angles. However, with legs in passing pose, the **near arm hand and blade sit directly between the two thigh silhouettes (~845,235–290)** — the arm/blade visually overlaps the front thigh. Reads as minor penetration/occlusion ambiguity rather than a joint defect.

**4) Blade:** Tip around (850,290) — **intersects the front thigh/shin silhouette region**. Flag: blade-through-leg contact.

---

## BL (Frame 3 — contact/down pose)

**1) Sword arm:** Shoulder (~272,518) → elbow (~300,585) → hand (~305,615). Angle ≈ **150–160°**, anterior fold — correct.

**2) Off arm:** Shoulder (~265,518) → elbow (~255,580) → hand (~258,610). Angle ≈ **165°**, correct direction; nearly straight again.

**3) Defects:** Joints clean, no hyperextension, no inversion, elbows below shoulders throughout. No dislocation reads.

**4) Blade:** Extends from hand toward the front foot; tip ~(315,640–660) — sits just above the front ankle/ground line. **No leg intersection**, but tip is within ~10–15px of the ground dashed line — lowest blade of the cycle, watch for ground clip at full extension.

---

## BR (Frame 4 — push-off pose)

**1) Sword arm:** Shoulder (~812,518) → elbow (~838,585) → hand (~842,612). Angle ≈ **155°**, correct anterior fold.

**2) Off arm:** Shoulder (~805,518) → elbow (~795,580) → hand (~798,610). Angle ≈ **165–170°**, correct direction.

**3) Defects:** None structural. Counter-phase preserved (near arm forward, far arm back). One soft note: the off arm swings **back far enough that its elbow nearly merges with the torso silhouette edge (~795,580)** — the far arm reads slightly "stuck" to the torso; add separation for readability.

**4) Blade:** Tip ~(850,655) pointing down-forward ahead of the leading foot. **No leg or ground intersection**; cleanest blade placement of the four frames.

---

## Summary

| Frame | Sword arm angle | Off arm angle | Hyperext | Blade issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TL | ~155° ✓ | ~170° ✓ | No | Grazes front shin |
| TR | ~155° ✓ | ~165° ✓ | No | **Blade overlaps front thigh** |
| BL | ~155° ✓ | ~165° ✓ | No | Near ground, no clip |
| BR | ~155° ✓ | ~168° ✓ | No | Clean |

All eight elbow flexions bend the correct way (anterior fold, no backward hyperextension), no elbows rise above shoulder height, no forearm/torso crossings, no dislocation reads. The only actionable fixes: **TR blade-thigh penetration** and the off-arm silhouette separation in BR. Off arm stays near-straight across all frames — consider +5–10° more flexion for natural swing.
